verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an open-source framework with a CLI and a cloud service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents vendor telemetry, usage tracking, or any switch to disable them. The built-in pipeline metrics are an adjacent, opt-in performance feature, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
